rubric: The other end of the rubric: a rewrite of about 150 files.

criteria.reviewable: Could one reviewer read this as one pull request with one purpose and follow it in one sitting?

reading.why: About 150 files fall in the largest files level, 50 files or more; the nearest closed change moved over 9,000 lines, so the lines level is the top, about 8,000 or more. No reviewer follows a rewrite of this size as one pull request.
